source_caption:
🎥🎬: MobLand (2025)

London’s criminal underworld is thrown into chaos when two powerful crime families become locked in a brutal struggle for control. Harry Da Souza, a trusted fixer with a reputation for solving impossible problems, is pulled directly into the conflict as loyalties begin to fracture.

What starts as a dispute between rival families quickly becomes personal, forcing Harry to navigate deception, violence, and betrayals from people he once trusted. With the Harrigan family determined to protect its empire, every decision carries consequences that could trigger an even bloodier war.

As alliances collapse and the body count rises, Harry finds himself caught between protecting his family and surviving the dangerous world he has spent years serving. In a criminal empire where power is everything, one wrong move could bring the entire operation crashing down.

source_details.synopsis: MobLand is a crime drama television series created by Ronan Bennett for Paramount+. The series stars Tom Hardy as Harry Da Souza, Pierce Brosnan as Conrad Harrigan and Helen Mirren as Maeve Harrigan. Additional main characters include Kevin Harrigan (Paddy Considine), Jan Da Souza (Joanne Froggatt), Isabella Harrigan (Lara Pulver), Eddie Harrigan (Anson Boon), and Seraphina Harrigan (Mandeep Dhillon). Guy Ritchie, Anthony Byrne, Daniel Syrkin, and Lawrence Gough serve as directors. Jez Butterworth and Bennett are credited with writing all ten episodes of the first season.
